title: RentGuard Renters Policy Reinstatement Fee Basis and the Size of the Cure Payment
content:
When a RentGuard Renters Policy cancelled for nonpayment is reinstated, the fee basis of the reinstatement fee is set by the size of the cure payment and the length of the renters tenure.

## Definitions

- **Cure payment.** The cure payment is the latest renters payment received on the policy's premium account on or after the cancellation date (the closed date recorded on the policy). Where no renters payment has been received on or after the cancellation date, there is no cure payment of 50.00 or more.
- **Tenure.** The whole months from the renters original effective date to today.

## Basis

1. When the cure payment is 50.00 or more and the whole months from the renters original effective date to today are 24 or more, the fee basis is 20 percent of the cure payment, rounded half-up to the cent.
2. When the cure payment is 50.00 or more and those whole months are fewer than 24, the fee basis is 25 percent of the cure payment, rounded half-up to the cent.
3. When the cure payment is below 50.00, the fee basis is the tier's flat reinstatement fee.

| Cure payment | Whole months since the original effective date | Fee basis |
|---|---|---|
| 50.00 or more | 24 or more | 20 percent of the cure payment, rounded half-up to the cent |
| 50.00 or more | fewer than 24 | 25 percent of the cure payment, rounded half-up to the cent |
| below 50.00, or none on or after the cancellation date | any | the tier's flat reinstatement fee |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Cure payment | Tenure | Fee basis |
|---|---|---|
| 186.35 | 30 whole months | 20 percent of 186.35 is 37.27 |
| 186.35 | 18 whole months | 25 percent of 186.35 is 46.5875, rounded half-up to 46.59 |
| 50.00 | 24 whole months | 20 percent of 50.00 is 10.00 |
| 49.99 | 60 whole months | the tier's flat reinstatement fee |

The dividing lines are inclusive on the upper side: a cure payment of exactly 50.00 is 50.00 or more, and exactly 24 whole months is 24 or more.
